status: review-only; not wired into the build
policy: Records omitted from this file are deliberate keeps from the source-audited translation.

changes.T25/g0/r0: Toward evening, Meyer finally returned… with a guest in tow.
changes.T25/g0/r1: Meyer: I have a very special guest. Allow me to introduce… Mr. Abraham Lincoln! George: P-President…! Lincoln: Hello. Meyer: He's touring the South.
changes.T25/g0/r2: Meyer: Yes, yes… by then he was already gone. The men from last night must have done it.
changes.T25/g0/r3: Soldier: Mr. President! Meyer: Oh! You're safe! …And alone, I see. Lincoln: Everyone is safe. Even Coyote…
changes.T25/g0/r4: Meyer: N-no… impossible! Lincoln: This time, you're coming with me. I'm afraid it will be a little cramped—and rather dark.
changes.T25/g0/r5: Wherever you're going, Devil, I'm coming after you—even to the deepest pits of Hell!
changes.T25/g0/r8: Soldier: Not even a rat will get past me!
changes.T25/g0/r11: Soldier 1: Your master is quite a man. When the South began to lose, he switched sides and supplied us with intelligence. Soldier 2: Hey, knock it off! Soldier 1: I'm just impressed by how well he always lands on his feet…
changes.T25/g0/r12: Lincoln: How terrible… Meyer: It is a grave problem. Deep prejudice still runs through the South. Lincoln: If there were more men like you, perhaps this war need never have happened.
changes.T25/g0/r17: Tall and thin. The set of his mouth speaks to a formidable will.
changes.T25/g0/r18: Lincoln: America will be born anew. The day will come when your talents can be put to good use.
changes.T25/g0/r19: Meyer: Take some coffee out to the guards on watch.
changes.T25/g0/r20: Meyer: You two can stop working and rest. Sleep in the upstairs guest room tonight, not that shack of yours. George: T-thank you.
changes.T25/g0/r21: I'm too nervous to say a word.
changes.T25/g0/r24: The guest room. Every corner is spotless.
changes.T25/g0/r25: He's bouncing around on the bed.
changes.T25/g0/r26: It has started to rain. A downpour is coming.
changes.T25/g0/r27: The rain is coming down in sheets.
changes.T25/g0/r28: George: I've never slept in a bed like this before. Wow…
changes.T25/g0/r29: George: I actually spoke to the President… Wow.
changes.T25/g1/r0: Me: ! George: M-mother…! Meyer: Belle! George! Come downstairs. I've got somewhere fun to take you.
changes.T25/g1/r5: A black leather whip… and a cloth hood with eyeholes.
changes.T25/g1/r6: Through the gap I can see… a black leather whip and a cloth hood with eyeholes.
changes.T25/g1/r8: I pull the drawer all the way out.
changes.T25/g1/r12: The stair landing. The entrance hall is below.
changes.T25/g1/r15: He won't stop talking to him.
changes.T25/g1/r16: So that's what he's really like.
changes.T25/g1/r17: Meyer: Need something? Me: No… nothing.
changes.T25/g1/r19: Lincoln: What is it you want? Meyer: A favor. I would like you to appoint me as a special adviser. Lincoln: … Meyer: A Southerner at your side would bring balance to your politics!
changes.T25/g1/r20: Lincoln: I must decline. I barely know you. Meyer: The men from last night are trying to kill you. I could put an end to all of their schemes…
changes.T25/g1/r21: Lincoln: This is a waste of time. Excuse me. He turns to leave… Meyer suddenly whistles. Lincoln: !
changes.T25/g1/r22: Meyer: Not so fast, Mr. President. Lincoln: G-guards…! Meyer: Fast asleep. The coffee was drugged.
changes.T25/g1/r23: Meyer: Have you reconsidered? Lincoln: Don't be absurd!
changes.T25/g1/r24: Meyer: Mr. President… I regret having to bring you somewhere like this. This island is the graveyard of slaves who disobeyed me. Another hour of rain and the whole place will be underwater…
changes.T25/g1/r25: He's shivering from cold and fear.
changes.T25/g1/r27: It looks ready to spring at us.
changes.T25/g1/r29: The water keeps rising. There's no chance of swimming across.
changes.T25/g2/r0: Lincoln: I cannot abandon all of you.
changes.T25/g2/r4: Meyer: Mr. President, this is your final chance. Leave the slaves behind and take the boat alone! Lincoln: … Meyer: Oh, one more thing. Coyotes stay calm when they face a group their own size or larger. Against a smaller group, they attack. Do be careful. I'll be waiting at the manor.
changes.T25/g2/r5: George: Oh no! The boat only holds two people.
changes.T25/g2/r7: George: We have to save everyone!
changes.T25/g2/r9: George: Mom's too heavy! The boat might sink!!
